verdict.rationale: 1Password documents storing one-time passwords (docs-20) and bulk import from many apps, including generic CSV files (docs-16, docs-23) and Credential Exchange on iOS/iPadOS 26+ (docs-17). However, none of the evidence says these import paths carry TOTP secrets or support authenticator apps specifically, so bulk token migration is only implied. Missing for 10: documented import from authenticator apps (e.g. their export formats or QR migration), confirmation that CSV or Credential Exchange imports include OTP seeds, and hands-on corroboration.
